$comment: Workflow hygiene for .github/workflows. Evaluated by scripts/check-policies.mjs; explained in policies/README.md and docs/security/SECURITY-AI.md section 5.

jobPermissionsSuffice.reason: Predates the policy and has no top-level permissions block. Its one job declares contents: read, packages: write, id-token: write, so the token is already scoped. Accepted only while every job in the file declares its own permissions; adding top-level permissions: {} is a Tier 2 follow-up (docs/TODO.md style), after which this entry should be removed.
